question: As of the year 2021, which of the following states/union territories produces the largest quantity of apples?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Jammu & Kashmir**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Around **80% of all apples** produced in the nation are produced in Jammu and Kashmir. With **annual earnings of over Rs. 1500 crores**, apple agriculture and its value chain are one of the foundations of rural economies.
 
• **Apple producing districts in Kashmir **-
 
 
• Srinagar, Ganderbal, Budgam, Baramulla, Kupwara, Anantnag, and Shopian districts produce the majority of the country's apples, However smaller amounts are also reported in Udhampur, Doda, Poonch, Ramban, and Reasi.
